sloka: धूम्राक्षस्तु धनुष्पाणिर्वानरान् रणमूर्धनि ।हसन् विद्रावयामास दिशस्तु शरवृष्टिभिः ।। ६.५२.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: dhūmrākṣastu dhanuṣpāṇirvānarān raṇamūrdhani ।hasan vidrāvayāmāsa diśastu śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 6.52.25 ।।।।

translations.english: Dhumraksha with his bow in hand, showering arrows, laughing in battlefront dispersed the Vanaras in directions.
